'''Gherant''' was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Gherant had been hand-picked by then-[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]] to an assignment aboard [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], where he was responsible for overseeing authorized access of the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer's]] sensitive areas.

During the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Gherant served aboard the ''Executor''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], under the command of the since-promoted [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] Piett, as the [[Fleet Commander/Legends|fleet commander]] of the giant [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|armada]] assembled to protect the unfinished [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] from [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] attack. Gherant [[Death/Legends|died]] during the battle along with Piett when a wayward Rebel [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]] crashed into the ''Executor''{{'s}} bridge tower, destroying the Super [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] shortly thereafter.

==Biography==
{{Quote|We're not going to attack?''"<br />"''I have my orders from the Emperor himself. He has something special planned for them. We only need to keep them from escaping.|Commander Gherant and Admiral Firmus Piett, regarding the ''Executor''{{'s}} role during the Battle of Endor|audio=WereNotGoingToAttack.flac|<ref name="ROTJ" />}}
[[File:Gherantdeath.png|thumb|left|300px|Gherant and Admiral Firmus Piett aboard the ''Executor'', moments before their deaths]]
Gherant was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], serving aboard<ref name="Dagobah">{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Commander Gherant}}</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]],<ref name="ROTJ" /> the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']],<ref name="Dagobah" /> attached to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]],<ref name="ROTJ" /> by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="date note">{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Executor}} is set around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> Prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]],<ref name="Piett note">{{Film|V}} shows [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]] being promoted to [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|admiral]] right before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. As {{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Commander Gherant}} specifically identified Gherant as being chosen by Captain Piett for service aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], this must have also occurred before the aforementioned battle.</ref> then-[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]] personally selected Gherant as a [[Deck officer/Legends|deck officer]] to Vader's [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]]. Gherant was responsible for preventing unauthorized access to sensitive areas of the ''Executor''.<ref name="Dagobah" />

Gherant's service aboard the ''Executor'' continued into<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> while Piett himself ascended to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in charge of Vader's flagship. During the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] of that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Gherant served aboard the ''Executor''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] alongside Piett as the [[Fleet Commander/Legends|fleet commander]] in charge of the massive Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Fleet/Legends|armada]] assembled in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]] to both protect the incomplete [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] and to ambush the imminently-arriving [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]], which had come to destroy the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].<ref name="ROTJ junior novel">[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]]</ref>

As the Imperial Fleet under Piett's command reached attack position at the beginning of the battle, Gherant was left flabbergasted by Piett's order for the ''Executor'' to refrain from engaging the Alliance Fleet. Piett explained that his orders came down from the highest authority&mdash;[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] himself had instructed the ''Executor'' and the remainder of the Imperial Fleet to simply hold the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] at bay to give the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star's]] secretly operational [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] the opportunity pick them off one by one.<ref name="ROTJ" />

[[File:StillObviouslyACar-ROTJ.png|thumb|right|300px|Gherant and Piett dive for cover as the Rebel A-wing smashes into the bridge.]]
Gherant and Piett both [[Death/Legends|died]] at the apex of the battle when the wayward [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] of [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Arvel Crynyd/Legends|Arvel Crynyd]] crashed into the ''Executor''{{'s}} unprotected command tower after the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer's]] main bridge [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] had been knocked out. Although Gherant had seen the starfighter barreling out of control toward the bridge, there was little<ref name="ROTJ" /> he<ref name="CSWE" /> could do to escape. With primary bridge control lost, the ''Executor'' plummeted into the Death Star's [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]], obliterating upon impact.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
During the Battle of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] Gherant was surprised to learn that the ''Executor'' would not enter the fray after reaching attack position. Gherant had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and light skin.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Equipment==
Commander Gherant wore the standard-issue [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|Imperial officer's uniform]] with a [[Hat/Legends|cap]] that included an [[Officer's disk/Legends|Imperial officer's disc]], a [[Rank insignia plaque/Legends|rank insignia plaque]] with three red and three blue squares, and a [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinder]] during the Battle of Endor.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Notable appearances===
Gherant first appeared in the<ref name="ROTJ novel">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref> [[May 12]], [[1983]]<ref name="Amazon">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], just prior to the film's theatrical release<ref name="ROTJ" /><ref name="ROTJ novel" /> on the [[May 25|25th]] of the same month.<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/critical-opinion-return-of-the-jedi-original-reviews|text=Critical Opinion: ''Return of the Jedi'' Original Reviews}}</ref> Actor [[Pip Miller]]<ref name="Pip Miller">{{WebCite|url=https://let-the-wookie-win.com/index.php?showimage=517|text=My Pip Miller Starwars Autograph|author=Oldbury, Dave Louis|date=2011-07-12|work=Star Wars Autograph Collecting|nobackup=1}}</ref> portrayed the character in the film and is credited as "Stardestroyer Captain #1."<ref name="ROTJ" /> Miller was dubbed by a United States actor post-production,<ref name="Aficionado">{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsaficionado|url=2011/11/behind-scenes-image-rebel-surprise.html|name=Star Wars Aficionado Magazine|text=BEHIND THE SCENES IMAGE: REBEL SURPRISE!}}</ref> and his scenes on the ''Executor'' were filmed on [[February 8]], [[1982]] in [[Wikipedia:England|England's]] [[Elstree Studios]].<ref name="Making">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>

The character was first named on the [http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Dagobah-Dark/large/commandergherant.gif "Commander Gherant" card] as part of the [[1997]] ''[[Dagobah Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]]. However, while the character is included in the ''Dagobah Limited'' set, which primarily includes characters seen in the<ref name="Dagobah" /> [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], Gherant's character does not actually appear in that film.<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>

===Inconsistencies===
The [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi Cine-Manga|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' PhotoComic]], which retells the film's story through live-action stills and accompanying speech bubbles with dialogue from the film, credits the line, "Sir, we've lost our bridge deflector shield!", to Gherant rather than the [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Executor)/Legends|''Executor'' bridge officer]] who speaks this line in the film. The PhotoComic also mistakenly credits Gherant's subsequent line, "Too late!," to Firmus Piett, and additionally incorrectly cites the line as "It's too late!"<ref name="ROTJ PhotoComic">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi Cine-Manga|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' Cine-Manga]]</ref>

Due to a costuming error during ''Return of the Jedi'' production, all [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] in the film, including Gherant, wore identical uniform insignia regardless of rank.<ref name="ROTJ" /><ref name="Insider 105">{{InsiderCite|105|25 Years of Return of the Jedi!|25 Years of ''Return of the Jedi''!}}</ref>
